words.ex_cn: 他昨晚点了一份披萨。
words.en: To request goods or services from a supplier or manufacturer.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的工作方式；指工作时间、地点或方式具有弹性的就业安排
words.ex: Many companies now offer flexible working to help employees balance life and work.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司现在提供灵活的工作方式，以帮助员工平衡生活与工作。
words.en: Flexible working refers to a work arrangement that allows employees to have control over their working hours and location, aiming to improve work-life balance and productivity.

words.tr: phrase. 加班工作；超时工作
words.ex: He is working overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他正在加班以完成这个项目。
words.en: To work beyond the regular working hours, often to complete a task or meet a deadline.

words.tr: n. 训练者；教练员；
words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.w: run through a few company policies
words.tr: phrase. 快速浏览或概述几项公司政策；过一遍公司政策
words.uk: rʌn θruː ə fjuː ˈkʌmpəni ˈpɒləsiz
words.us: rʌn θru ə fju ˈkʌmpəni ˈpɑləsiz
words.ex: He ran through a few company policies in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上快速讲了几项公司政策。
words.en: Briefly review or examine several company policies.

words.tr: phrase. 无限制的访问权限；无限访问
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: Unlimited access refers to the ability to use or enter something without any restrictions or limits.

words.tr: adj. 试用的；
words.ex: He is on probationary status at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中处于试用期。
words.en: Relating to a period of testing or trial, especially for a new employee or a criminal on parole.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；符合某事的条件
words.ex: He is eligible for a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.

words.tr: n. 部；部门；系；
words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.tr: 个人情况：指个人的背景、经历、家庭状况等个人方面的情况。
words.ex: He changed his plan because of his personal circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 他因为个人情况改变了计划。
words.en: Personal circumstances refer to the conditions or factors affecting a person's life and decisions, often used to explain changes in behavior, decisions, or situations.

words.w: don't assume you'l lautomatically be permitted to do this
words.tr: 不要以为你会自动被允许这样做
words.uk: dəʊnt əˈsjuːm juːl ɔːˌtɒmətɪkli bi ˈpɜːmɪtɪd tu dʊ ðɪs
words.us: doʊnt əˈsuːm juːl ɔːˌtɑːmətɪkli bi ˈpɝːmɪtɪd tu du ðɪs
words.ex_cn: 不要以为你自动就能被允许做这件事。
words.en: Do not believe you will be allowed to do this without asking first.

words.tr: phrase. 法定公共假日；由法律规定必须放假的公众节日
words.ex: The government declared May 1st as a statutory public holiday.
words.ex_cn: 政府将5月1日定为法定公共假日。
words.en: A day on which most businesses and other institutions are closed, officially recognized by the government.

words.tr: phrase. 开始从事（某项活动、爱好等）；占用（时间、空间等）；继续（中断的事）
words.ex: He decided to take up gardening in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在空闲时间开始从事园艺。
words.en: To start doing something regularly as a habit, job, or interest; to fill or occupy time or space.

words.tr: n.承诺
words.ex: He has many family commitments on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末有很多家庭事务要处理。
words.en: A commitment is a promise or firm decision to do something, or the fact of promising to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 着装规范
words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: phrase. 高跟鞋
words.ex: She walks in high heels to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着高跟鞋去参加派对。
words.en: High heels are women's shoes with high, narrow heels.

words.tr: n. 食堂
words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.tr: phrase. 没有打包的午餐；未自带盒饭
words.ex: He has no packed lunch today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天没有带盒饭。
words.en: The absence of a meal prepared at home and brought to eat elsewhere, typically at work or school.

words.tr: adj. 不卫生的，不干净的；
words.ex: The kitchen was unhygienic and full of dirt.
words.ex_cn: 厨房很不卫生，到处都是脏东西。
words.en: If you describe something as unhygienic, you mean that it is dirty and likely to cause illness or disease.

words.tr: phrase. 克服身体上的困难；战胜体能障碍
words.ex: He overcame physical difficulties to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了身体上的困难，完成了比赛。
words.en: Surmount physical obstacles or challenges.

words.tr: phrase. 重新发现（在往昔岁月里因痴呆症而被孤立的感受）
words.ex: He rediscovered isolation past times dementia when he visited his grandmother in the nursing home.
words.ex_cn: 当他去养老院看望祖母时，他重新体会到了因痴呆症而在往昔岁月里被孤立的感受。
words.en: To recall or experience past times of solitude again, often due to dementia.

words.w: take sb back to their youth dressmaker
words.tr: phrase. 使某人回想起年轻时光的裁缝（通常指因裁缝作品或风格唤起青春回忆）
words.uk: teɪk sb bæk tu ðeir juːθ ˈdresməkə(r)
words.us: teɪk sb bæk tu ðer juθ ˈdresmekər
words.ex: The old dressmaker took her back to her youth with a dress like the ones she wore at 18.
words.ex_cn: 那位老裁缝用一件像她18岁时穿过的裙子，让她回想起了青春时光。
words.en: To take someone back in memory to their youth, as if by a dressmaker.

words.tr: 短语. 达到某人的标准；符合某人的要求
words.ex: His work is not up to his standard.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作没有达到他的标准。
words.en: Meeting or exceeding someone's expectations or requirements.

words.tr: phrase. 获得很多快乐；从……中得到极大乐趣
words.ex: He gains a lot of pleasure from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他从读书中获得很多快乐。
words.en: To derive great enjoyment or satisfaction from an activity.

words.tr: n. 自尊心
words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 表达自己的思想或情感
words.ex: Children can express themselves through drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们可以通过画画来表达自己。
words.en: To communicate one's thoughts or feelings through speech, writing, or some other form of art.

words.tr: phrase. 永久职位；长期稳定的工作
words.ex: He wants a permanent job to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一份永久工作来养家。
words.en: A permanent job is a position that is intended to last indefinitely, as opposed to a temporary or contract position.

words.tr: phrase. 带领团队；领导一个团队
words.ex: He leads a team of five engineers.
words.ex_cn: 他带领一个由五名工程师组成的团队。
words.en: To be in charge of and direct a group of people working towards a common goal.

words.tr: phrase. 高强度工作；密集型劳动；需要高度集中精力的工作
words.ex: He did intensive work to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了密集的工作以按时完成项目。
words.en: Intensive work refers to work that is done with a lot of effort and concentration, often over a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 赚取更多；获得更高的收入
words.ex: He works harder to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力工作以赚更多钱。
words.en: To obtain a higher amount of money, typically through work or investment.

words.tr: n. 加班；
words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.tr: phrase. 快速晋升；迅速提拔
words.ex: He got rapid promotion because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为努力工作而得到了快速晋升。
words.en: The act of moving someone to a higher position or rank in a company or organization at a fast pace.

words.tr: phrase. 本地旅行；在本地范围内的出行活动
words.ex: We plan local travel this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们这个周末计划本地旅行。
words.en: Journeying within a limited geographical area, often for leisure or short trips.

words.tr: phrase. 低利润率；低利润边际
words.ex: The store has low-profit margins on milk and bread.
words.ex_cn: 这家店在牛奶和面包上的利润很低。
words.en: Low-profit margins refer to the small difference between the cost of producing goods or services and the revenue generated from selling them, indicating a low level of profitability.

words.tr: adj. 好交际的；
words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.tr: phrase. 沿着…向上移动；向…高处前进；努力攀登…
words.ex: The hikers made their way up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者沿着山向上移动。
words.en: To progress or advance to a higher position or level.

words.tr: phrase. 职业阶梯；事业晋升途径
words.ex: He climbed the career ladder quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速爬上了职业阶梯。
words.en: The progressive sequence of jobs or positions that lead to higher levels of responsibility and pay in a profession.

words.tr: phrase. 为期12个月的产假
words.ex: She took a month maternity leave after giving birth.
words.ex_cn: 她生完孩子后休了12个月的产假。
words.en: The period of leave from work granted to a mother around the time of childbirth.

words.tr: phrase. 作为报答
words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase. 有竞争力的薪酬；指薪资水平在市场上具有吸引力，能够与同类职位相比较并具备优势
words.ex: The company offers a competitive salary to attract top talent.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供有竞争力的薪酬以吸引顶尖人才。
words.en: A competitive salary is a wage that is high enough to attract and retain employees, especially in comparison to what other employers are offering for similar positions.

words.w: rent a small cottage on the estate
words.tr: phrase. 在庄园里租一间小别墅
words.uk: rent ə smɔːl ˈkɒtɪdʒ ɒn ðə ˈestət
words.us: rent ə smɔːl ˈkɑːtɪdʒ ɑːn ðə ˈestət
words.ex: They rent a small cottage on the estate.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了庄园里的一间小农舍。
words.en: To lease a modest dwelling situated on a larger property or land.

words.tr: n. 拖拉机；
words.ex: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里开拖拉机。
words.en: A tractor is a powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment and trailers.

words.tr: phrase. 人员流动率
words.ex: The company has high staff turnover this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这家公司的员工流动率很高。
words.en: The rate at which employees leave a workforce and are replaced.

words.tr: n. 动机；诱因；
words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 重视某人的意见有助于（某事）
words.ex: Your opinions contribute to better decisions, so we value them.
words.ex_cn: 你的意见有助于做出更好的决定，所以我们重视它们。
words.en: To consider one's own views as important and worth expressing, thereby adding to a discussion or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 员工留任；指企业或组织保留现有员工的能力或策略
words.ex: The company offers good pay to improve staff retention.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供良好的薪酬以提高员工留任率。
words.en: Staff retention refers to the ability of a company or organization to keep its employees and prevent them from leaving.

words.tr: phrase. 引入一项方案；推出一项计划
words.ex: The school will introduce a scheme to help students with homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校将推出一个帮助学生做作业的计划。
words.en: To establish or launch a new plan, system, or initiative.

words.tr: n. 才能；天才；
words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.tr: phrase. 组织培训：计划和安排一系列的活动，以便向员工、学生或其他人员提供特定的知识或技能。
words.ex: He will organize training for new employees next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将为新员工组织培训。
words.en: To arrange and manage educational or skill-development sessions.

words.tr: phrase. 高成就者；取得突出成绩的人
words.ex: High achievers usually finish their homework early.
words.ex_cn: 高成就者通常会早早完成作业。
words.en: People who are high achievers are those who accomplish a great deal, especially in their careers or education.

words.tr: phrase. 酒店连锁集团；连锁酒店
words.ex: He works for a big hotel chain.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大型连锁酒店工作。
words.en: A hotel chain is a company that owns or operates several hotels, often in different locations, under the same brand.

words.tr: 短语. 作为奖励；作为报答
words.ex: He got a toy as a reward for cleaning his room.
words.ex_cn: 他因为打扫房间而得到了一个玩具作为奖励。
words.en: Given as a prize or benefit for good work or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 全部费用已付的旅行；由他人或机构承担所有费用的旅程
words.ex: He won an all-expenses-paid trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了一次全包的巴黎之旅。
words.en: A trip where all costs are covered by someone else, such as an employer or a contest sponsor.

words.tr: adj. 额外的；附加的；
words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童保育责任合作社；一种由承担儿童照护责任的个人或家庭共同组建的合作组织，旨在分担育儿任务和资源
words.ex: The childcare responsibilities cooperative helps parents share babysitting duties.
words.ex_cn: 儿童保育责任合作社帮助家长分担看孩子的工作。
words.en: The shared duty of looking after children, often involving mutual support and collaboration.

words.tr: phrase. 筹钱
words.ex: They are trying to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在努力为学校筹钱。
words.en: To collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or for a political campaign.

words.tr: n. 创造力；创造；
words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr: phrase. 新颖的方法；新奇的方式
words.ex: He found a novel way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种新颖的方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: A new or original method or approach to doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 收集箱；捐款箱；用于收集物品或钱款的箱子
words.ex: He put money into the collection box.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱放进收集箱里。
words.en: A container, typically found in public places, where people can deposit money as a donation to a charity or cause.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾收集；废弃物收集
words.ex: Volunteers did litter collection in the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者在公园里进行了垃圾收集。
words.en: The act of collecting waste materials from public places to maintain cleanliness and hygiene.

words.tr:
adj. 漫长而艰难的；
adv. 朝上坡方向；
words.ex: Losing weight is an uphill task for many people.
words.ex_cn: 对许多人来说，减肥是一项漫长而艰难的任务。
words.en: If something is uphill, it is going up a slope or hill. If you say that something is uphill, you mean that it is difficult and requires effort.

words.tr: n. 空缺；
words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.tr: 动词短语，给出明确的指示；清楚地说明该做什么
words.ex: He gives clear instructions to his students.
words.ex_cn: 他给学生清晰的指示。
words.en: To provide unambiguous and easy-to-follow guidance or directions.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: adj. 剧场的；戏剧性的；
words.ex: The theatrical lighting made the stage look magical.
words.ex_cn: 剧场的灯光让舞台显得神奇。
words.en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre or to the performance of plays. It can also describe behaviour that is exaggerated and intended to attract attention.

words.tr: n. 损伤；伤害；
words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.tr: adv. 最初；
words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr: phrase. 父母养育技能；教养孩子的技巧
words.ex: Parenting skills help parents care for their children.
words.ex_cn: 育儿技能帮助父母照顾孩子。
words.en: Parenting skills refer to the abilities and knowledge that parents use to raise their children effectively.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的体能水平；健康状况良好
words.ex: He has a good level of fitness from running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步，拥有良好的体能水平。
words.en: A satisfactory or proficient state of physical health and strength.

words.tr: n. 筹款；
words.ex: The school held a bake sale for fundraising.
words.ex_cn: 学校举办了一个烘焙义卖来筹款。
words.en: Fundraising is the activity of collecting money to support a charity or political campaign or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 数量加倍并增强
words.ex: The population doubled in number and strengthened the community.
words.ex_cn: 人口数量翻了一番，增强了社区的力量。
words.en: Increased twofold in quantity or size, and also made stronger or more resilient.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时关闭的
words.ex: The shop is temporarily closed for cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店因清洁而暂时关闭。
words.en: The phrase 'temporarily closed' means that a place or service is not available or accessible for a short period of time, usually due to maintenance, repairs, or other temporary issues.

words.tr: phrase. 售票处；票房收入
words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.tr: phrase. 更衣室；化妆室
words.ex: She went to the dressing room to change her clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她去更衣室换衣服。
words.en: A room where people change their clothes, especially in a theater or sports facility.

words.tr: v. 重新开办；
words.ex: The shop will reopen next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店下周一重新开业。
words.en: To open again after being closed.

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.tr: n. 门厅；
words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.tr: v. 重漆；
words.ex: He will repaint the old house next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会重新粉刷那栋老房子。
words.en: To paint something again, especially a building or a picture.

words.tr: v. 重新确定方向；
words.ex: He reoriented his career toward teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他将职业方向重新确定为教学。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.tr: phrase. 新场所；新办公地点；新营业场所
words.ex: The company moved to new premises last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月搬到了新的场所。
words.en: A new location or building for a business or organization.

words.tr: n. 礼堂；观众席；
words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr: phrase. 每排座位之间的腿部空间
words.uk: ðə leɡ ruːm bɪˈtwiːn ðə rəʊz
words.us: ðə leɡ ruːm bɪˈtwiːn ðə roʊz
words.ex: The leg-room between the rows is too small.
words.ex_cn: 排与排之间的腿部空间太小了。
words.en: The space available for leg movement between rows of seats.

words.tr: phrase. 安装空调系统；安装冷气设备
words.ex: They install air conditioning in the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们给房子里安装空调。
words.en: To fit a system for cooling the air in a building.

words.tr: adj. 闷热的；
words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.tr: adj. 通风的；
words.ex: The room is airy with windows on all sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间四面都有窗户，通风很好。
words.en: If a place or room is airy, it has a lot of fresh air because it is large or has a lot of windows.

words.tr: n. 轮椅
words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr: [经] 满足要求
words.ex: The factory works hard to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂努力满足需求。
words.en: To satisfy the need or desire for something.

words.tr: adj. 效率高的
words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr:
n. 后台；
adv. 在后台；
words.ex: The actors waited backstage before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前在后台等候。
words.en: Behind the scenes in a theater or relating to the private lives of people in the entertainment industry.

words.tr: phrase. 被转换成；被变成
words.ex: The water can be converted into steam.
words.ex_cn: 水可以被转化为蒸汽。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way.

words.tr: phrase. 照明设施；照明系统
words.ex: The school fixed the lighting system last week.
words.ex_cn: 学校上周修好了照明系统。
words.en: A lighting system refers to the equipment and arrangement used to provide light in a space, including fixtures, controls, and the power supply.

words.tr: n. 帷幕；窗帘；
words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.tr: v. 延长；扩展；提供；
words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.tr: v. 重新刷新；翻新；整修
words.ex: They will refurbish the old house next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月将翻新这栋老房子。
words.en: To refurbish something means to clean it, decorate it, and provide it with new equipment or facilities, especially so that it is more attractive or more useful.

words.tr: n. 目的；意图；
words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: v. 减少；降低；减量；
words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr: phrase. 新管理层；新的管理方式；新的管理团队
words.ex: The company has new management this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年有了新的管理层。
words.en: The term 'new management' refers to a change in the individuals or team responsible for running and making decisions within an organization. It often implies a shift in strategy, culture, or operational focus.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: phrase. 自然保护区
words.ex: The birds live in a nature reserve.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在自然保护区。
words.en: A nature reserve is a protected area of importance for wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest, which is reserved and managed for conservation and to provide special opportunities for study or research.

words.tr: n. 许可；批准；
words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr: adj. 多层的
words.ex: The multi-storey building has ten floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座多层建筑有十层。
words.en: A multi-storey building has several floors or levels.

words.tr: v. 拒绝；不接受；
words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.tr: 毗邻土地：指与某一块土地相邻的另一块土地，通常用于描述房地产或土地所有权的范围。
words.ex: The house has adjoining land for a garden.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一块相邻的土地用作花园。
words.en: Land that is next to or shares a boundary with another piece of land.

words.tr: phrase. 在另一地点重新开放
words.ex: The store will reopen on a different site next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店下个月将在另一个地点重新开业。
words.en: To start operating again at a different location.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.tr: v. 重新装饰；翻新装修；“redecorate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: They redecorated their living room last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周重新装修了客厅。
words.en: To decorate something again or differently.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 扩大；放大；
words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.tr: phrase. 在不太遥远的将来；在不久的将来
words.uk: ɪn ðə ˌnɒt tuː ˈdɪstənt ˈfjuːtʃə
words.us: ɪn ðə ˌnɑːt tuː ˈdɪstənt ˈfjuːtʃər
words.ex: In the not-too-distant future, robots will help us at home.
words.ex_cn: 在不远的将来，机器人将帮助我们做家务。
words.en: A period of time that is not very far away from the present.

words.w: this is by no means definite
words.tr: 这绝非确定无疑的
words.ex: This is by no means definite, so we should keep looking for other options.
words.ex_cn: 这绝不是确定的，所以我们应该继续寻找其他选择。
words.en: This phrase is used to indicate that something is not certain or fixed and may be changed.

words.tr: phrase. 负责该区域；主管该地区
words.ex: He is in charge of the area.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个区域。
words.en: Responsible for managing or overseeing a specific region.

words.tr: n. 责任；职责；
words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.tr: phrase. 一个国家机构；全国性组织
words.ex: A national body sets rules for schools.
words.ex_cn: 一个国家级机构为学校制定规则。
words.en: A national body refers to an organization or institution that operates at the national level, often established by the government to oversee or regulate specific areas of public interest.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比高的；物有所值的
words.ex: This phone is good value for money.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机物有所值。
words.en: If something is good value for money, it is worth the amount of money that you pay for it.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr: v. 雇佣；使用；
words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.tr: phrase. 有机食品
words.ex: She buys organic food at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上购买有机食品。
words.en: Food produced without the use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, or other artificial chemicals.

words.tr: phrase. 素食菜肴；指不含肉类或鱼类的餐点
words.ex: She cooks vegetarian dishes every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都做素食菜肴。
words.en: Dishes that are made without any meat or fish, often emphasizing vegetables, grains, and sometimes dairy products or eggs.

words.tr: n. 客户；
words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.tr: n. 学费；指导；
words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 山地自行车运动；山地骑行
words.ex: He enjoys mountain biking on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山地自行车骑行。
words.en: Mountain biking is the sport of riding bicycles off-road, often over rough terrain, using specially designed mountain bikes.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.tr: phrase. ……的积极特征；……的优点；……的正面特点
words.ex: The positive features of this phone are its long battery and clear screen.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的优点是电池续航长和屏幕清晰。
words.en: The beneficial or advantageous aspects of something, often used to highlight its strengths or positive qualities.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.tr: phrase. 志同道合的人
words.ex: He enjoys spending time with like-minded people who share his interests.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和志同道合的人待在一起，他们有相同的兴趣。
words.en: People who share similar opinions, attitudes, or interests.

words.tr: phrase. 正赛签表；正赛阶段（指锦标赛从第一轮开始的正式比赛，而非预选赛）
words.ex: The top players are all in the main draw.
words.ex_cn: 所有顶尖球员都在正赛签表中。
words.en: The primary attraction or the most important event in a tournament or festival.

words.tr: n. 初学者；新手；
words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: adj. 额外的；附加的；
words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.tr: phrase. 通常的；惯常的 + n. 强调；重点；重音
words.ex: He gives usual emphasis to punctuality.
words.ex_cn: 他通常强调守时。
words.en: The standard or typical stress placed on a particular word or syllable in speech or writing.

words.tr: 短语. 已知条件；理所当然的事
words.ex: He solved the problem with a given number.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个给定的数字解决了这个问题。
words.en: A fact or situation that is accepted as true or existing without needing proof.

words.tr: phrase. 无肉食谱；不含肉类的菜谱
words.ex: She cooks meat-free recipes for her family.
words.ex_cn: 她为家人做无肉食谱。
words.en: Recipes that do not contain any meat or animal flesh, typically using plant-based ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 一对一辅导；个别授课；私人教学
words.ex: He gets one-on-one tuition in math every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都接受一对一的数学辅导。
words.en: One-on-one tuition refers to a method of teaching where a single student is taught by a single teacher, allowing for personalized instruction and attention.

words.tr: n. 短途旅行；
words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.tr: n. 展览；展出；
words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: n. 咨询；磋商；
words.ex: He had a consultation with the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他与医生进行了一次咨询。
words.en: A consultation is a meeting which is held to discuss something. Consultation is discussion about something that is still being planned.

words.w: clients find that they end up losing much of the stress they've built up their daily lives
words.tr: 短语. 客户发现他们最终会失去日常生活中积累的大部分压力
words.ex: Clients find that they end up losing much of the stress they've built up in their daily lives.
words.ex_cn: 客户发现他们最终会失去日常生活中积累的大部分压力。
words.en: A phrase indicating that clients reduce the accumulated stress from their everyday routines.

words.tr: phrase. 减肥计划；饮食方案
words.ex: He follows a diet programme to lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一个减肥饮食计划。
words.en: A diet programme is a structured plan designed to promote healthy eating habits and improve overall health by specifying what, when, and how much to eat.

words.tr: phrase. 最受欢迎的功能；最热门的特色
words.ex: These are the most popular features of the new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这些是这款新手机最流行的功能。
words.en: The most popular features refer to the aspects or functionalities of a product, service, or system that are most liked or preferred by the majority of users.

words.tr: phrase. 专为……量身定制；针对……特别设计
words.ex: The program is tailored to beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个课程专为初学者设计。
words.en: Customized or designed to suit a specific person, group, or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 很少的兴趣；缺乏兴趣
words.ex: He has little interest in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学没什么兴趣。
words.en: A lack of enthusiasm, attention, or concern for something.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr: phrase. 在他们七十多岁的时候；处于七十至七十九岁之间
words.ex: My grandparents are in their seventies and they still travel every year.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父母七十多岁了，他们仍然每年都旅行。
words.en: Aged between 70 and 79 years old.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的模型；陈旧的型号
words.ex: The company stopped using outdated models.
words.ex_cn: 公司停止使用过时的模型。
words.en: Old-fashioned or obsolete systems, ideas, or methods.

words.tr: phrase. 发送短信；发文字信息
words.ex: He likes to send texts to his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天给朋友发短信。
words.en: To send written messages via a mobile phone or similar device.

words.tr: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的；
words.ex: He gave a dismissive shrug when she explained her idea.
words.ex_cn: 当她解释自己的想法时，他轻蔑地耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you are dismissive of someone or something, you show that you do not consider them to be important or worth considering.

words.tr: phrase. 订购他们的食品杂货；下单购买他们的日常食品
words.ex: They order their groceries online every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周在线订购杂货。
words.en: To arrange for food and other household items to be delivered to one's home.

words.tr: phrase. v. 派上用场；变得有用
words.ex: This tool will come in handy when you fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 当你修自行车时，这个工具会派上用场。
words.en: If an object or skill comes in handy, it is useful in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 视力；景象；眼界；见解
words.ex: They couldn't see the difference without their glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他们不戴眼镜就看不到那个区别。
words.en: They were unable to perceive or understand the...

words.tr: phrase. 更新他们技能的意义/目的
words.ex: He sees the point of updating their skills to get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 他明白更新技能是为了找到更好的工作。
words.en: The moment or stage at which it is necessary to update one's skills to maintain or improve competence.

words.w: we'll make sure we include this time
words.tr: 我们会确保这次包含在内
words.uk: wɛl meɪk ʃʊə wɪ ɪnˈkluːd ðɪs taɪm
words.us: wɛl meɪk ʃʊr wɪ ɪnˈkluːd ðɪs taɪm
words.ex: We'll make sure we include this time.
words.ex_cn: 我们会确保包括这次时间。
words.en: We will ensure that this is included in our plans for this occasion.

words.tr: n. 就职；感应；
words.ex: The induction of the new mayor will be held next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新市长的就职典礼将在下周一举行。
words.en: Induction is the process or action of inducting someone to a position or organization, or the process of reasoning from specific cases to general rules.

words.tr: n. 学徒期；
words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.tr: v. 反应
words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: adv. 积极地；肯定地；
words.ex: He positively believes in his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他积极地相信自己的梦想。
words.en: In a positive manner; with certainty.

words.tr: adj.建立信任的
words.ex: She does yoga for confidence-building.
words.ex_cn: 她做瑜伽来增强自信。
words.en: Actions or measures taken to increase trust between parties, especially in a political or military context.

words.tr: phrase. 每周时间表；周计划表
words.ex: He checks his weekly timetable every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一查看他的周课程表。
words.en: A schedule of activities or classes organized on a weekly basis.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: adj. 和蔼可亲的；
words.ex: The teacher is very approachable and always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as approachable, you think that they are friendly and easy to talk to.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮你一把；助你脱困
words.ex: He is helping you out with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在帮你做作业。
words.en: Providing assistance or support to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 努力去做某事
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To try hard to do something.

words.tr: n. 主管人；
words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: n. 导师；顾问；
words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.tr: phrase. 体力活动；身体运动
words.ex: He does physical activity every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行体育活动。
words.en: Physical activity refers to any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure.

words.tr: phrase. 独立感与轻松氛围的结合
words.ex: He feels a sense of independence in a relaxed atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 他在轻松的氛围中感受到独立感。
words.en: A feeling of self-reliance combined with a casual, unhurried environment.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.tr: v. 指导；监督；管理；
words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr: phrase. 建立自信；培养信心
words.ex: He practices speaking to develop confidence.
words.ex_cn: 他练习说话以建立自信。
words.en: To build or acquire self-assurance and belief in one's own abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 大家庭；扩大的家庭（如数代同堂的家庭）
words.ex: He lives with his extended family in a big house.
words.ex_cn: 他和大家庭住在一起，住在一所大房子里。
words.en: A family group that consists of parents, children, and other close relatives, often living in close proximity.

words.tr: v. 说服；
words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr: n. （车辆等的）停放；停车场所；停车位； v. “park”的现在分词；
words.ex: There is no parking near the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校附近没有停车的地方。
words.en: Parking refers to the act of stopping a vehicle and leaving it temporarily in a particular place.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.tr: adj. 超过平均水平的
words.ex: He has an above-average IQ.
words.ex_cn: 他的智商高于平均水平。
words.en: Better than the usual or ordinary level or standard.

words.tr: phrase. 国外旅行
words.ex: He plans overseas travel next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年夏天去国外旅行。
words.en: Travel to a foreign country, especially one across the sea.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.tr: phrase. 身体健康
words.ex: He does exercise every day to improve his physical fitness.
words.ex_cn: 他每天锻炼以提高身体健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong, especially as a result of exercise and proper nutrition.

words.tr: n. 招聘；
words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 维持；维修；保养；
words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.tr: phrase. 兼顾工作与其他责任；在工作和其他职责之间周旋
words.ex: She juggles work with other responsibilities every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天同时兼顾工作和其他责任。
words.en: To manage or balance a job alongside other duties or commitments.

words.tr: phrase. 儿童保育；照顾孩子
words.ex: She decided to stay at home to provide child care for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她决定留在家里为她的宝宝提供儿童保育。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a person or organization while the parents are at work or absent.

words.tr: phrase. 一个很大的优点；非常有利的因素
words.ex: Walking to school is a big plus for my health.
words.ex_cn: 步行上学对我的健康是个很大的好处。
words.en: A big plus is something that is very beneficial or advantageous.

words.tr: adj. 多风的；有风的；
words.ex: It is a windy day today.
words.ex_cn: 今天是多风的一天。
words.en: If it is windy, the wind is blowing a lot.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.tr: phrase. 地理特征
words.ex: The map shows many geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图展示了山脉和河流等许多地理特征。
words.en: Geographical features refer to the natural and artificial physical characteristics of a place or region, including its landforms, bodies of water, climate, soils, natural vegetation, and animal life.

words.tr: 短语. 轻松获得当地设施；便于使用本地设施
words.ex: The park has easy access to local facilities like shops and buses.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园方便地连接着商店和公交车等本地设施。
words.en: Convenient availability of nearby services or amenities.

words.tr: phrase. 农业价值很小；几乎没有农业价值
words.ex: The little agriculture value made the farmers poor.
words.ex_cn: 很少的农业价值让农民变得贫穷。
words.en: Agricultural activity or land with minimal economic or productive worth.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车的人
words.ex: The cyclist rides his bike every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位骑自行车的人每天早上骑车。
words.en: A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的关系；友好的交往
words.ex: They have a good relation with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们与邻居关系良好。
words.en: A good relation refers to a positive and beneficial connection or association between people, groups, or countries.

words.tr: adj. 农村的；乡村的；
words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.tr: phrase. 中学
words.ex: He teaches math in a secondary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所中学教数学。
words.en: A secondary school is a school for pupils between the ages of 11 or 12 and 18.

words.tr: phrase. 自然特征；天然地貌；自然景观
words.ex: The park has many natural features like rivers and forests.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有许多如河流和森林这样的自然特征。
words.en: Natural features refer to the physical elements of the Earth's surface that are not made by humans, such as mountains, rivers, and forests.

words.tr: n. 景色；风景画；
words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: n. 供应；预备；
words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.tr: n. 野生生物；
words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr: n. 努力；
words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.tr: adj. 可达到的；
words.ex: The goal is achievable with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 通过努力，这个目标是可以达到的。
words.en: If something is achievable, it is possible to achieve it.

words.tr: phrase. 时间限制；时限
words.ex: We have a time limit of ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我们有十分钟的时间限制。
words.en: A time limit is a deadline by which something must be done or completed.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的意图；善意的打算
words.ex: He has good intention to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助朋友的好意。
words.en: A good intention refers to a kind or benevolent purpose behind an action, even if the outcome is not as expected.

words.tr: n. 决心；测定；
words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.tr: n. 承诺；奉献；
words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: adj. 可管理的；可应付的；可处理的；
words.ex: The project is manageable if we work together.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们一起合作，这个项目是可以管理的。
words.en: If you describe something as manageable, you mean that it is easy to control or deal with.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: adj. 灵活的；柔韧的；
words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.tr: n. 退步；挫折
words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr: phrase. 必定会发生的；注定要成为的
words.ex: He is bound to be late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 由于交通堵塞，他肯定会迟到。
words.en: Certain or very likely to happen or be true.

words.tr: v. 装饰；装修；
words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 目标感；使命感；明确的目的意识
words.ex: He found a sense of purpose after volunteering at the shelter.
words.ex_cn: 他在志愿帮助收容所后找到了人生目标感。
words.en: A feeling of having a definite aim or goal in life.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理；对时间的有效规划与控制
words.ex: He practices time management to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他练习时间管理，以便早点完成作业。
words.en: The process of planning and exercising conscious control over the amount of time spent on specific activities, especially to increase effectiveness, efficiency, or productivity.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: n. 前景；希望；
words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr: phrase. 养家糊口；支撑一个家庭的经济或生活需求
words.ex: He works two jobs to support a family.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来养活一家人。
words.en: provide the financial means for a family to live

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr: adv. 明智地；
words.ex: She sensibly saved money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 她明智地为将来存钱。
words.en: In a way that shows good judgment; reasonably.

words.tr: n. 壁纸；
words.ex: They bought new wallpaper for the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们为卧室买了新壁纸。
words.en: Wallpaper is a material used to cover and decorate the interior walls of homes, offices, and other buildings; it is usually sold in rolls and is applied onto the wall using wallpaper paste.

words.tr: prep. 在…旁边；与…一起；
words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.tr: v. 替人临时照看（小孩）
words.ex: She babysits her neighbor's child every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周五帮邻居照看孩子。
words.en: To babysit means to take care of children in the absence of their parents, usually for a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 应付；处理
words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: adj. 心理的；精神的；
words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人持肯定态度；看好某人
words.ex: The teacher looks favourably on him because he always works hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师对他印象很好，因为他总是努力学习。
words.en: To regard someone or something with approval or support.

words.tr: phrase. 在那方面；就那一点而言
words.ex: He is not good at math, in that respect, he needs more practice.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上不好，在这方面，他需要更多练习。
words.en: In that particular aspect or regard.

words.tr: verb phrase付额外的费用【动词短语】
words.ex: He pays extra for faster delivery.
words.ex_cn: 他为更快的配送多付钱。
words.en: To pay an additional amount of money for something, often for a service or feature that is not included in the standard price.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得减少；得到折扣或减免
words.ex: He got a reduction on his bill.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了账单的折扣。
words.en: Obtain a decrease in price or cost.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；参与
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: n. 服装；衣服；
words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr: n. 休闲娱乐；
words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 三道菜的一餐（通常包括前菜、主菜和甜点）
words.ex: They had a three-course meal at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他们在餐厅吃了一顿三道菜的饭。
words.en: A meal consisting of three separate courses, typically including a starter, main course, and dessert.

words.tr: phrase. 无限量的免费饮品
words.ex: The party offers unlimited free drinks for all guests.
words.ex_cn: 派对为所有客人提供无限量的免费饮料。
words.en: An unlimited supply of complimentary beverages.

words.tr: phrase. 演员阵容；演出成员（指一部戏剧、电影或电视节目中的所有演员）
words.ex: The cast members acted together in the play.
words.ex_cn: 这些演员在剧中一起表演。
words.en: The actors and actresses who perform in a play, film, or television show.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人聊天；与某人闲谈
words.ex: I like to chat with my friend every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢每天晚上和朋友聊天。
words.en: Engage in conversation with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 长袍；长礼服；长睡袍
words.ex: The dancers wore long gowns at the show.
words.ex_cn: 舞者们在表演时穿着长裙。
words.en: Lengthy, formal dresses or robes.

words.tr: phrase. 中世纪方式：指中世纪时期的生活方式、文化、社会制度等。
words.ex: They used a medieval way to farm the land.
words.ex_cn: 他们用一种中世纪的方式耕种土地。
words.en: In the manner of the Middle Ages; ancient or outdated methods.

words.tr: n. 餐具（刀、叉和匙）；
words.ex: She placed the cutlery neatly on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把餐具整齐地放在桌子上。
words.en: Cutlery refers to the tools used for eating or serving food, such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.tr: n. 马背；
words.ex: He rode the horse on horseback.
words.ex_cn: 他骑在马背上。
words.en: If you do something on horseback, you do it while riding a horse.

words.tr: phrase. 敲击舞厅（字面义）；指代特定舞蹈场所或比喻性表达
words.ex: They heard a loud knock ballroom from the empty hall.
words.ex_cn: 他们听到空大厅里传来一阵敲击舞厅的响声。
words.en: To strike a ball in a dance hall, typically as part of a rhythmic or social activity.

words.tr: phrase. 无付款；未支付；无需付款
words.ex: There is no payment for this service.
words.ex_cn: 这项服务不需要付款。
words.en: The absence of payment for goods or services.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: phrase. 棕榈树
words.ex: The palm tree stands near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树站在海滩附近。
words.en: A palm tree is a type of tree that grows in hot countries and has a tall trunk with a mass of long pointed leaves at the top.

words.tr: phrase. 热带地区：指位于赤道附近的气候带，气候温暖潮湿，植被繁茂，动植物种类丰富。
words.ex: Monkeys live in the tropical region.
words.ex_cn: 猴子生活在热带地区。
words.en: A tropical region is a geographical area located near the equator, characterized by a hot and humid climate, and is home to a wide variety of flora and fauna.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄情绪；宣泄精力；释放压力
words.ex: He runs every day to let off steam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步来发泄情绪。
words.en: If you let off steam, you get rid of your energy, anger, or strong emotions by doing something active or noisy.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 全年的；一年到头的
words.ex: He works year-round at the ice cream shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在冰淇淋店全年工作。
words.en: Something that is year-round exists, happens, or is done throughout the year.

words.tr: phrase. 不论他们的年龄；不管他们多大年纪
words.ex: All students can join, irrespective of their age.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都可以加入，无论他们的年龄如何。
words.en: Without considering or being affected by their age.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；密切注视
words.ex: Please keep an eye on the baby while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请照看一下宝宝。
words.en: To watch or look after someone or something carefully.

words.tr: adj. 灾难性的
words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr: phrase. 收集；收藏品；采集物
words.ex: He enjoys the collection of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢收集旧硬币。
words.en: A group of items gathered together, often for a specific purpose or as a hobby.

words.w: oo expensive to replace up to now
words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止仍过于昂贵而无法更换的
words.uk: tuːɪkˈspensɪv tuː rɪˈpleɪs ʌp tuː naʊ
words.us: tuːɪkˈspɛnsɪv tuː rɪˈpleɪs ʌp tuː naʊ
words.ex: The old machine is still too expensive to replace up to now.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器迄今为止仍过于昂贵而无法更换。
words.en: Extremely costly to purchase again, and this has been the case up to the present time.

words.tr: 谁配备了人员（指为某机构、项目等安排工作人员）
words.ex: The government who staffed it hired teachers and nurses.
words.ex_cn: 政府为它配备了教师和护士。
words.en: Who provided the personnel for it.

words.tr: 它是由什么建造的（用于询问某物的构成材料或技术）
words.ex: I want to know what it was built with.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道它是用什么建造的。
words.en: The materials used in its construction.

words.tr: n. 海豚
words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.tr: n. 企鹅
words.ex: The penguin walks on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅在冰上行走。
words.en: A penguin is a type of bird that cannot fly, lives in the southern hemisphere, and swims very well.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 步行；走路
words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.tr: n. 海难；
words.ex: The old shipwreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的残骸躺在海底。
words.en: A shipwreck is the destruction of a ship at sea by sinking or breaking up, for example in a storm or after hitting a rock.

words.tr: n. 悬崖；
words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.tr: phrase. 偏僻的地点；与世隔绝之处；孤立的小点
words.ex: He sat in an isolated spot by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在湖边一个偏僻的地方。
words.en: A place that is far from others and not easily reached or accessed.

words.tr: phrase. 砍柴；劈柴（将木头劈成适合燃烧的小块）
words.ex: He is chopping firewood for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为冬天砍柴。
words.en: Cutting wood into smaller pieces for fuel.

words.tr: phrase. 接管；接任；取代
words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr: phrase. , n.突然出现：指突然从隐藏的位置迅速出现或活动。; 弹出式：指在打开页面时形成一个立体结构的设备或插图。...
words.ex: A message will pop up when you open the app.
words.ex_cn: 当你打开应用程序时，会弹出一条消息。
words.en: If something such as a message or window pops up on a computer screen, it appears there suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: n. 皮船；爱斯基摩小艇；
words.ex: He paddled his kayak down the river.
words.ex_cn: 他划着皮船顺流而下。
words.en: A kayak is a small, narrow boat which is propelled by means of a double-bladed paddle.

words.tr: phrase. 一条狭窄的水道；狭窄的通道
words.ex: The boat passed through a narrow channel between two islands.
words.ex_cn: 船从两个岛屿之间的一个狭窄水道穿过。
words.en: A narrow channel is a small passage of water connecting two larger bodies of water or a passage between two landmasses.

words.tr: phrase. 岩层
words.ex: The rock formation looks very old.
words.ex_cn: 这个岩石构造看起来非常古老。
words.en: A rock formation is a body of rock identified by lithic characteristics and stratigraphic position.

words.tr: phrase. 延长的营业时间；延长的工作时间
words.ex: The store offers extended hours during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在节日期间提供延长的营业时间。
words.en: Extended hours refer to periods of time that are longer than the usual or standard hours of operation.

words.tr: phrase. 学校学期；教学时段
words.ex: School sessions start in September and end in June.
words.ex_cn: 学期从九月开始，六月结束。
words.en: Periods of academic instruction at a school.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 每个孩子；按每个儿童计算
words.ex: The cost is $50 per child.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子的费用是50美元。
words.en: For each child.

words.tr: n. 过敏症；
words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: phrase. 已在我们这里注册的；已向我们登记的
words.ex: He registered with us last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周在我们这里注册了。
words.en: Officially recorded or enrolled with our organization.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.tr: n. 意大利面食
words.ex: He eats pasta for dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃意大利面。
words.en: Pasta is a type of food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, and water that is formed into different shapes and then boiled.

words.tr: n. 学期
words.ex: He lives at home during term-time.
words.ex_cn: 他在学期期间住在家里。
words.en: The period during which educational institutions are in session.

words.tr: n. 保险
words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: adj. 可靠的；
words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: adj. 继续的；连续的；
words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.tr: phrase. 承诺程度；投入水平；忠诚度
words.ex: He showed a high level of commitment to his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对工作表现出高度的投入。
words.en: The degree to which someone is dedicated to a cause or activity.

words.tr: n. 野心；雄心；抱负；
words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: phrase. 有点被压扁的；有点拥挤的；有点变形的
words.ex: The boxes were a bit squashed in the truck.
words.ex_cn: 箱子里在卡车上被压得有点扁。
words.en: Slightly flattened or compressed from its normal shape.

words.tr: n. 考虑；
words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.tr: n. 可靠
words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.tr: phrase. 根据我们的经验；就我们的经历而言
words.ex: In our experience, students learn faster with practice.
words.ex_cn: 根据我们的经验，学生通过练习学得更快。
words.en: Based on our collective observation and knowledge.

words.tr: n. 奉献；献身；
words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.tr: adj. 忠诚的；
words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.tr: n. 毒素；毒质；
words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.tr: adj. 有毒的
words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr: v. 消耗；消费；
words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr: adj. 类似的；相像的；
words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: phrase. 变得困惑；感到迷糊
words.ex: He gets confused when people speak too fast.
words.ex_cn: 当人们说话太快时，他会感到困惑。
words.en: Become uncertain or mistaken about something.

words.w: several days old and past their best
words.tr: phrase. 已存放数日且过了最佳状态的
words.uk: /ˈsevərəl deɪz əʊld ænd pɑːst ðeə bɛst/
words.us: /ˈsɛvərəl deɪz oʊld ænd pæst ðer bɛst/
words.ex: The apples are several days old and past their best.
words.ex_cn: 这些苹果放了几天，已经不新鲜了。
words.en: Several days old and no longer at their peak quality.

words.tr: adj. （颜色）淡的；苍白的；
words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.tr: n.松鼠
words.ex: Squirrels run fast in the park.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠在公园里跑得很快。
words.en: Small rodents with bushy tails, known for their ability to climb trees and for gathering and storing nuts.
